maddeler.e:
نتخابث (form VI)
# نَتَخَابَثُ (nataḵābaṯu) /na.ta.xaː.ba.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَابَثَ (taḵābaṯa)
# نَتَخَابَثَ (nataḵābaṯa) /na.ta.xaː.ba.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَابَثَ (taḵābaṯa)
# نَتَخَابَثْ (nataḵābaṯ) /na.ta.xaː.baθ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَابَثَ (taḵābaṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
